Residences at Garrya Phuket

Condominium in Laguna Phuket (Bang Tao Beach)
HomeSaleResidences at Garrya Phuket

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Residences at Garrya Phuket are apartments within the new Garrya hotel on Bang Tao Beach, part of the Laguna Phuket resort run by Banyan Group. The four-storey building has only two to three units per floor: two-bedroom apartments of about 113 to 115 sqm and two- and three-bedroom penthouses of about 215 to 220 sqm with private rooftop pools. A small number of east-facing one-bedroom apartments of about 57 sqm are sold separately from the hotel programme.

The concept is wellness-led. Facilities include a hydrotherapy zone with hot and cold baths, sauna and steam rooms, a beach club with a lap pool and a party pool, and jungle pools. Owners can put their unit into the hotel inventory or rent it through Banyan Living, and join the Sanctuary Club and the Laguna Advantage programme (golf, school-fee and healthcare benefits).

Banyan Group released the final phase of penthouses in November 2025. Agents give completion as Q3 2026; ask us for the current handover schedule.
